description: Source code for rebase-interactive functionality in Git, including handling of todo lists, commit checks, and rebase instructions.

methods.name: get_missing_commit_check_level
methods.description: Determines the level of missing commit check based on repository configuration.

methods.name: append_todo_help
methods.description: Appends help and instructions for the rebase todo list to a buffer.

methods.name: edit_todo_list
methods.description: Handles editing, parsing, and validation of the rebase todo list.

methods.name: todo_list_check
methods.description: Checks for dropped commits and unrecognized commands in the todo list.

methods.name: todo_list_check_against_backup
methods.description: Compares current todo list against backup to detect inconsistencies.
